ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.9.0 RC1 integration branch for RimWorld 1.5. The release-candidate architecture consolidates the validated path/search infrastructure and S5.3 WorkGiver candidate-source optimization into the main RimMT assembly. BuildRoof, GrowerHarvest, ClearSnow and DoBill use bounded candidate pruning while Vanilla/third-party Job creation, reservation, reachability and final selection remain authoritative. GrowerSow accepts only source-reviewed Biomes/ReGrowth boundaries and otherwise fails closed; Tend remains fail-closed around unreviewed Smart Medicine authority patches. Heavy S5.2 NoResult profiling is removed from the production assembly. This branch must not replace the user's newer S5.1 Hybrid Tail Rescue runtime until that exact baseline is merged.
